svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Lint enforcement architecture
svg.desc: Entry points call the lint engine, which now consults a compiled policy module before any finding is allowed to block. Configuration seeds its defaults from that same policy.
